review:
A candy factory on Megaways, with a mixer as the wild – and every wild carries a random 1x to 3x multiplier.

Three or more scatters give free spins with sticky wilds, so a bonus with a few early wilds (each carrying multipliers) can snowball fast. Very high volatility, a 12,960x max and a strong 96.96% RTP. Free spins about once every 259 spins.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
